messages:
maria-finance: Heads-up — Evora (acct EVR-498) called. Invoice `2023-11-INV-341` marked as returned by bank (R07). Amount $72,430. They say internal spend stalled; propose a 3-month split payment and waive the $1,450 late fee. They can commit to the first installment ($24,143) today if we can set up the plan and avoid suspension. Can finance/legal approve?
sam-accounts: Got the ACH return notice from their bank. Copy pasted: `ACH R07 - Authorization revoked by customer`. We can resubmit once we get a signed authorization or accept card. FYI our policy needs manager signoff for >$50k.
trevor-sales: Evora is in our strategic SMB program. Recommend approving 3-installments 0% if they sign annual renewal clause. I'll get the PO today — they want continuity.
elaine-cs: Customer is anxious about downtime. If we accept a plan, let's add a 2-week no-suspend grace and daily usage alerts. CS can monitor.
billing-bot: [system] Invoice 2023-11-INV-341 status -> PAYMENT_RETURNED (R07) @1934560000. Note created: "return:evora:R07".
legal-team: We can draft a short payment agreement. Need sign-off on: payment schedule, no-suspend clause, and updated T&Cs. We prefer company sig + billing contact. Approve provisional plan until docs signed.
sam-accounts: Approve provisional acceptance pending PO and signed plan. I will not blacklist the account yet but will flag for daily follow. If PO received, I'll queue ACH resubmission and process first installment.
maria-finance: Thanks. I'll draft the 3-installment payment plan (dates, amounts, ACH/card options) and attach to the thread. Trevor — can you confirm PO ETA? We should also record the collection step: outreach -> payment plan offered -> await PO/signed plan -> resubmit ACH.
trevor-sales: Confirmed — PO ETA 21:00 PT today. I'll DM the billing contact and get signature on the plan.
maria-finance: Perfect. Tagging billing-bot to add collection tag and timeline: `payment-plan:evora:3x`; will upload draft contract once legal posts it.
billing-bot: [system] Tag added: payment-plan:evora:3x. Reminder set: follow-up in 48h.
elaine-cs: I'll send a short customer note: "we've placed a temporary hold on suspension while we finalize the plan" and set alerts to the account team.
legal-team: Draft uploaded to Google Drive (link posted in DM). Once signed, please CC legal-team@redwood for record.
maria-finance: Ok — provisional approval recorded. If we don't have PO/signature by EOD tomorrow, we'll move to standard dunning cadence. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
